prompts.4: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE hand-painted RTS game sprite on real transparent background, landscape canvas 3:2. Reference images are style/material only: pale gray beige twisted caatinga bark in arvore-seca, cut wood warm pale beige from woodcutters. A felled dry caatinga tree LYING FLAT ON THE GROUND, seen top-down three-quarter for orthogonal 64px tiles, Brazilian Paraiba sertao 1930s. NOT standing, NOT upright. The round elliptical sawn basal face with fine growth rings must have its CENTER exactly at (50% canvas width,50% canvas height). From that cut face the thick twisted trunk runs diagonally toward UPPER RIGHT, ending in a spreading branching crown of bare dry twigs occupying upper right quadrant, with some side branches. All tree contained within canvas, generous transparent space to left and below. Tree length from cut to tip about 42% canvas width and 40% canvas height. Pale gray beige fibrous bark, warm pale cut end, subtle brushwork and readable game silhouette, matches provided existing game trees, NOT photorealistic, NOT pixel art, NOT 1998 RTS. Single light from overhead slightly SOUTH (screen bottom), absolutely no east-west lighting component; no long cast shadow, no ground, no leaves, no text, no borders, no other objects. Need clean alpha. Intended downsample to 192x128.
